sentences.en: The geographical features here are similar to those of our prefecture.
sentences.zh: 这里的地理特征与我们地区的相似。

sentences.en: The geographical south pole is the Earth's southernmost point.
sentences.zh: 地理南极是地球最南端的点。

sentences.en: Algeria's geographical position offers it countless advantages.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚的地理位置为它带来了无数优势。
